fields.label: Places
fields.name: ltt_dive_in_map_places
fields.instructions: Optional markers shown on the map. Selecting a marker shows its details. Places are also listed as text when the map cannot load.

sub_fields.label: Name
sub_fields.name: name
sub_fields.instructions: Shown next to the marker, for example “Tahoe City”.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Optional short description shown when the place is selected.

sub_fields.label: Latitude
sub_fields.name: latitude
sub_fields.instructions: Decimal degrees, for example 39.1677. In Google Maps, right-click the place and copy the first number.

sub_fields.label: Longitude
sub_fields.name: longitude
sub_fields.instructions: Decimal degrees, for example -120.1452 (negative in North America). The second number copied from Google Maps.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Use a descriptive link text such as “Explore Tahoe City”; a link without text is not shown.
